title: openalex_W7119509037
universal_lens: A unified framework for quantifying football offensive contributions through event-based metrics and automated assist detection using machine learning. Inter-rater reliability quantified via Fleiss' κ enables robust human-labeled data confidence assessment across multi-rater nominal variables.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian probabilistic models infer player impact from event sequences; conformal prediction ensures robustness against vendor-specific definitions. Bayesian inference framework applied to IRR estimates for probabilistic label confidence and uncertainty quantification in expert-labeled datasets.
gse_mapping: Situationally aware state transitions model player roles and team dynamics via action-event chains; temporal logic encodes decision-making paths. Situation-aware state transitions model inter-labeler inconsistencies during assist definition refinement, enabling dynamic policy adjustment.

The robustness of these models is evaluated through cross-validation and comparison against baseline configurations.
